name: U302 3V3_MAIN buck
source: TI LMQ66430-Q1 datasheet SNVSBV1F (rev. F, September 2026), 8.5.1 Layout Guidelines and Figure 8-34; no numeric limits given (input caps 'as close as possible to the VIN and GND terminals', SW area 'short and wide', feedback 'close to the VOUT / FB pin', away from SW)

name: U303 1V5_CORE buck (TPS628502-Q1, DEC-026)
source: TI TPS62850x-Q1 datasheet SLUSDM0N (January 2026), 9.5.1 Layout Guidelines and Figure 9-61; no numeric limits given (input cap 'as close as possible between the VIN and GND pin', switched-current paths 'as short and wide as possible', FB resistors 'close to the IC', FB 'not nearby high dv/dt signals (for example, SW)')
